reviews.text: We love the doctors and the staff. They are courteous, professional and genuinely care. We have had two dogs taken care of by Colina and our experience has been great both times. They are kind and attentive and have given us great care and advice. I fully trust this hospital and highly recommend.

I've been to Colina Vet multiple times with my pets and my friends pets, every time they're prompt and through and get the job done, within a reasonable price I've been able to work with, thank God my cats have only needed a few dental extractions and vaccines, would recommend, a happy pet parent. 🐱🐈🐾

I'm going to keep this a short as possible.  I reported this business to the Business Better Burea today reporting them as scammers.  I made a very important appointment for my pug with skin sensitivity for the cytopoint injection, over the phone.  I agreed to pay the requested first time exam / yearly fee and they charged my account $69 and informed me of their next availability for next week specifically Wednesday 4pm.  Absolutely received no courtesy confirmation email or text saying I made this appointment and received no appointment confirmation.  And that's the SCAM.  They have a no show policy they told me about whrn I made the appointment on the phone, and I said great.  If I could I would have seen her that day but I had to wait. I showed up to my appointment for them to tell me I missed my appointment and the receptionist gave me a fake day and time that I supposedly miss that wasn't on my  google calendar that I jotted down.  I said absolueltly not, I see what you're doing.  Because there was no confirmation of the appointment this business thinks they can scam new customers whom they require to pay a $69 first time exam fee in order to make your appointment. SHAMELESS.  I was still seen because the vet doctor came out and said he'll see me because of the arguing back and forth which I told him the same thing I spoke about to the scammer  receptionist.  I told the receptionist I am not paying a second time when I didn't miss my appointment.   She forcefully continued to inform the policy of a no show on me and I stood my ground and said absolutely not.

Brought my baby Luna here for her vaccines. The staff was all friendly. They took her to the back give her her shots, quick and easy. I lost my paperwork. I think I accidentally threw it away. I emailed them for a copy and they sent it to me automatically with no problems. I was recommended here for my friend and I’m glad I found a new place for my puppy to go to.

I’ve never used Colina Vet Hospital for my own pets but had a great experience here with a lost dog I found. They helped scan him for a microchip, located the owner, and offered to hold him until the family could pick him up. I appreciated how kind and helpful the staff was!

I had to take in my senior cat who would’ve been 20yrs old this winter for Euthanasia.
Although my first experience with them was during one of the saddest of visits they were all great. From the person who answered my phone call to the vet who performed the euthanasia and everyone in between. Everyone was professional and caring. THANK YOU ALL.

I took my cat in for a dental procedure, it was a good experience. The staff was kind and helpful, the drop-off process was easy, and the cost of services was extremely reasonable. I was able to get my cat the vet care that she needed without excessive stress or financial strain, and without sacrificing the quality of her care. The staff was also very patient with me when I called with questions prior to the appointment. I would highly recommend this clinic.
Had my 9 year old dog neutered there. Hes doing great. Thank you!

I would like to start by saying the staff was nice from booking my appointment all the way to check out but I feel the DVM lacks knowledge & care when being attentive to their patients. I went in for a first time exam on Thursday and took my dog here after having a friend express that they were kind. I went in with concerns that my dog was experiencing an anal gland infection. During exam DVM stated the glands were “impacted” and I was send home with Probiotics, not antibiotics.. I also asked DVM for pain meds since my pet was uncomfortable. No bloodwork was ran to check my pets liver or kidneys to take these pain meds. After going home my pet still was having a hard night. I called Friday AM and asked for the DVM to call me back. I was told I’d get a call by end of day Friday. I never received a call back and it’s now Monday. I ended up taking my pet to ER on Friday night where her anal gland was showing signs of an abscess not “impacted”. Colina Vet may be a cheaper priced vet in SD but it’s not worth your money to go here.

Dr. Guajardo and his son are always kind and gentle with my little Nala. In the past, I've had veterinarians ask if they can muzzle her up. I've never understood why. She's a nervous dog but has never been given a reason to bite anyone. Anyway, the veterinarians here are amaIng. Nala behaves really well around them. The Vet techs are good- Nala does particularly well around Rosie and doesn't tremble. I'm not sure why she does with the other techs. I know it's standard practice to take the pets to the back when conducting a heartworm snap test or administering vaccines- I always request to be present for it all. The front desk girls are nice. The parking entrance is a little weird but overall decent.

Dr Gs and their team are amazing! They are kind, caring, and really listen. My whole family takes our precious pets to Colina Vetrinary and we wouldn't dream of going anywhere else for care for our babies.
Such a wonderful group of people,  very professional and caring.
The staff is kind and knowledgeable the doctor is to the point and cares.
I trust the staff and doctors here. They’re a good group of people who treat me and my pets well. And their prices are reasonable too.
Highly satisfied with the results
Friendly professional service at super cheap price compared to one other nameless vet clinic ... its under $200 here with the same service vs around $1300 at the other clinic.
Amazing and kind people. Take great care of pets.

I really liked this office, the care my pet received the staff, & doctor, and felt the cost was extremely reasonable. As a 15 year veteran of the veterinary industry, I’m very choosy about my pets care, and I was pleased to find that this doctor provided a step-by-step, conservative diagnostics plan, rather than starting with an estimate that encompasses everything under the sun. The staff was nice, the doctor was friendly and patient. I got prompt lab work results over the phone. The recommendations were right in line with my knowledge of the problem. This will definitely be our veterinarian from here on.

We took our dog Sunny to see Dr Jesus Guajardo. This Veterinary clinic & their wonderful, kind staff are a miracle and all I can say is they've done wonders for extending the life of our little Maltese poodle who is suffering from seizures and other inherited spinal issues relieved his pain and eliminated his seizures and put him back in a good place thank you so much!
Fantastic service cheap nice and wonderful service to my dogs

My family has had good experiences for many decades at this Vet. They've done a good job with several of our pets throughout the years. The Father/Son duo and their team are wonderful and care about the animals. They also don't mind answering whatever questions you may have.

I will only take my dogs here. They truly care for animals and do EVERYTHING they can to help. My dogs get excited to see the staff & the veterinarians. My male dog is so relaxed there he lays down to nap. Best care anywhere.
Very attentive

I am so grateful to have found Dr. Guarjardo after my old vet retired. He's very  knowledgeable and extremely  kind and patient! He's willing to actively listen to all of  your concerns about your pet with empathy and  truly respects your input, even though he has been doing this a long time. He's an authentically kind and calm person who always puts my "scardy cat" at ease by immediately giving him warm pets and using his calming voice on him. AFTER ALL OF HIS YEARS AS A VET YOU CAN TELL.HE STILL .LOVES WHAT HE DOES AND KEEPS UP ON CURRENT RESEACH ALONG WITH HIS WISON GAINED FROM HIS MANY YEARS  WORKING AS AN AWESOME VET!
He's HONEST, KIND AFFORDABLE & CARES! The ladies at the front desk are also very kind and super efficient and very personable! The few vet techs I have.met are also very friendly as well. I highly recommend this Vet office  and the doctors that work here!

A friend recommended me to come and I’m so happy she did. By far the most affordable vet I’ve found in San Diego.  I’ve gotten my dog’s teeth cleaned here twice and it’s been great! Hopefully I can get my cats in soon (they hate the car) I’ve seen a few bad reviews because they make you put a deposit down, this is pretty standard these days for most appointments for anything. I own a hair salon and we make everyone  atleast have credit card in file to charge if they don’t show up.  It’s about making sure people respect others time. I highly recommend this vet.
Excellent service
Dr. Guajardo is the best at what he does. 😁 …
They are very friendly and take great care of your pet.
I bring both my dogs here, Cain and Trouble.  The vet is so kind and takes his time with you and your pets. It's a great place to bring your pets.
Been there any time I need profesional care for our furry ones
Very quick, affordable service. I called 5 different places prior to choosing them & haven’t had such a good experience in SD yet! Love them. Will be back.

Very disappointed in this place, I used to bring all my pets to this place due to Dr. Guajardo. He was very good with all my animals and treatment used to be afforable but ever since his son has been taking over his pratice the level of service has gone way down. I got a irritated with them in particular due to a recent change in their handling of booking appointments,  putting a deposit down before coming in, I recently had to visit two different veterinarian hospitals because we couldn't book with him and we received great care and more afforable treatment and no deposit required. I guess the reason for them enforcing that is due to high volumes of cancelation? Maybe there is a reason why, people don't get the same level of professionalism and decide to go else where. They also decided to flag us instead of trying to discuss with us and taking my complaint seriously , we have been taking our dog there for years never had a issue with staff until recently. Well it won't be a loss, guess we'll be taking our business elsewhere. I wouldn't recommend this place. Such a shame.

I have been going here for 14 years and they always take the best care of my dogs. They take into consideration the cost and will give estimates if needed and will disclose the costs before proceeding. I always feel so welcomed and comfortable with all the staff there. Thank you for all the care you have done for my dogs over the years.
They were very nice! I did need to go on to a 24hr animal hospital from there but they were kind and helpful!

I brought my cat here for dental work because of the good reviews and affordability. For a dental cleaning and one extraction, the total was around $543 (including the cost of the visit). Compared to other places, which were over $800, it was very affordable. I am very grateful. Dr. Jesus did a great job. I requested before-and-after pictures of the surgery, and they were very willing and cooperative. The pictures were a bit graphic, but the area healed within 1-2 weeks. Thank you to Dr. Jesus and all the staff for making this possible and caring for my pet. :)
Good people

Excellent vets, excellent staff, and reasonable prices. We love taking our animals here. The vets do a great job diagnosing any issues and treating them. The staff is very nice too. We will definitely return

My family has gone to this clinic since the late 70s. I've always brought my dogs here because Dr. G really cared about them. And the vets are great. But they just implemented a new policy where you must pay a deposit up-front for appointments. I just paid them $1600 for a knee surgery for my dog last month and now I can't take him in without paying a deposit up-front.

I informed their receptionist this is a classist, anti-poor policy. That I cannot afford a per-dog, per-appointment deposit. I have never once missed one of my dogs' appointments. I am heartbroken that cost and indifference are being prioritized over people and pets. So after all these years, I will no longer recommend Colina to people or take them my animals.
Love the folks here. Bring all 3 dogs
